items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: Neil Miner, my bass player, does a lot of arrangements too.

ctx.x: Well thank you for leading into my next question. What do you think singers should be able to convey to their band?

Everything. Unless you want to have a musical director who you need to be able to communicate clearly with, and a lot of singers choose to do that. I mean I don’t have a musical director but my pianist, Michael, he does a lot of the arrangements, he holds on to all the charts for us, my bass player, I should say Michael Kanan. Neil Miner, my bass player, does a lot of arrangements too. My husband, Rick Montalbano, helps out a lot with the tour managing and just doing all the day-to-day business with our…
Well how much of that did you learn at the Manhattan School of Music?
